decisions.title: Manual edits are sacred
decisions.rationale: prelude update must never overwrite hand-edited fields. src/core/state-manager.ts tracks which fields are inferred vs manually edited, and src/core/merger.ts preserves manual edits during update (module purposes and notes in map.json, project name/description/relatedProjects).

decisions.title: Regex heuristics, not AST parsers
decisions.rationale: Inference and scanning (src/core/infer.ts, src/core/source-scanner.ts, src/core/map-scanner.ts) use fs/promises, path, and regex only. No heavy runtime dependencies. A wrong pointer in the map costs one wasted read, so regex-grade accuracy is acceptable for routing.

decisions.title: Schemas are the contract
decisions.rationale: Every .context/ file has a Zod schema in src/schema/ and a JSON Schema in schemas/, kept in sync. JSON Schemas set additionalProperties: true for forward compatibility; new fields are optional.

decisions.title: One resolveContextDir for external brain mode
decisions.rationale: src/runtime/context.ts resolveContextDir() is the only place that reads PRELUDE_ROOT. Embedded mode uses <root>/.context; external brain mode uses <PRELUDE_ROOT>/<project basename>.
